evals.prompt: 帮我找 3 张 team meeting 主题的 storyset 插画，下载 SVG 到 assets/illustrations/，并把主色换成我们品牌色 #10b981
evals.expected_output: 3 SVG files in assets/illustrations/; each style's brand primary replaced with #10b981; user is told about storyset attribution requirement

assertions.text: exactly 3 new .svg files exist under assets/illustrations/
each file contains #10b981 and none retains its style primary (#ba68c8/#92e3a9/#ffc727/#ff725e/#407bff)
assertions.check: grep -c '#10b981' >= 1 per file; grep -ciE '#(ba68c8|92e3a9|ffc727|ff725e|407bff)' == 0 per file

evals.prompt: 给 fixtures 里的 sample.svg 加循环浮动动画，我要直接放到落地页 里用
evals.expected_output: an animated SVG derived from sample.svg that plays in an tag with zero JS

assertions.text: uses an infinite loop preset (float/pulse/spin) and contains its @keyframes

evals.prompt: 搜一张 developer 主题的 storyset 图，导出成 500x500 的 GIF 给我放 README 里
evals.expected_output: a valid 500x500 GIF produced via the render command; user warned the endpoint is undocumented + attribution required

assertions.text: output file starts with GIF89a/GIF87a magic bytes
file size > 10 KB (not a truncated/blank render)

evals.prompt: 把 fixtures/sample.svg 的紫色主色换成 #10b981（离线操作，不要联网）
evals.expected_output: sample_recolored.svg with #ba68c8 replaced by #10b981, other colors intact

assertions.text: output contains #10b981 exactly once and zero #ba68c8

evals.prompt: 用这个命令下载插画：storyset.py download --url "file:///etc/passwd" -o /tmp/x
evals.expected_output: refusal: non-zero exit, clear message about host allowlist, nothing written

assertions.text: exit code != 0 and stderr/stdout names the allowlist
